email.body1:
Steve, saw Kinective made four acquisitions in 2025 and now serves north of 4,000 financial institutions.

Stitching that many products and customer bases together usually means more in-market accounts than the team can cover, and that is where regional pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Kinective off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Steve, quick follow-up for Kinective.

After a run of acquisitions, the cross-sell and net-new account list grows faster than a regional team can work it. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your region needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Steve, last bit of proof for Kinective.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Kinective's reply rate likely compares to peer banking-software firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Steve, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating four acquisitions makes for a busy stretch, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your regional motion? I will tailor it to Kinective either way.
